place.source_title: Henry C. Bull House, 195 East Third Street

brief: Two-storey frame house begun 1878 for a prominent Cokato financier (demolished 1988): a hipped main block with cross gables, a corner tower with a bell-cast pyramidal cap, canted bays, shuttered 1/1 windows, clapboard walls and spindled porches on two sides, on a corner lot under the village water tower.

floors: W Wb W D W D
facade.notes: an 1879 clapboard house turned Queen Anne: a corner tower with a bell-cast roof and finial, two-storey bays with bracketed roofs, several small porches with turned posts, shutters on the upper windows; on a corner lot right on the sidewalk, a stop sign, a cobra-head street light, the town's water tower ('COKATO') behind

why.note: a Minnesota town's leading family adds the fashionable corner tower
the prominent corner lot on Main Street's edge for a merchant's house
